fixtures.env: E0 Cyrene + E0 Boothill (Basic engine, no Chrysos/Remembrance ally so the A2 'Ripples Across Time' grant stays off) vs a dummy Elite (atk 200, Ice+Physical weakness, 600 Toughness), 8 cycles, seed 5. energyStartFrac 0.5 opens the unprecendent phase: Skill 'Bloom, Elysium of Beyond' deploys the 2-turn Zone (True DMG 24%), the Basic 'Lo, Hope Takes Flight!' fills 1 Recollection, and 6 actions push the Recollection pool (energyMax 24) to the threshold. Then the once-per-battle Ultimate 'Verse ◦ Vow ∞' (141503): drains 12, summons the off-timeline Demiurge (MaxHP = Cyrene's, SPD 0), enters the Ripples state with permanent Zone and the CRIT-rate buff 'Remembrance, Sung in Ripples', lets Demiurge cast 'This Ode, to All Lives', and activates ready teammate Ultimates (Boothill starts empty -> skipped). From then on only the Enhanced Basic 'To Love and Tomorrow' heals Recollection and the Ripples-state Ultimate 'Reunion at First Sight' drains 12 and gives Demiurge an extra turn (Minuet of Blooms and Plumes + Ode to Ego, 1 bounce from Boothill's consumed Future). Verifies E0 only: no E2 start +12, no E6 DEF shred.

requirements.claim: Talent 'Hearts Gather as One': while Cyrene is on field all ally targets gain DMG — permanent buff cy_heart (remembrance.ts:1840-1845).
Basic ATK Lo, Hope Takes Flight! (141501, Ice) is the kit's Basic and fires in the fixture.

requirements.claim: Engine: at full Recollection the kit performs the once-per-battle Verse, logs the stance/Zone/crit grant and the ally-Ultimate fan-out.
